info.name: SMemories - notes
info.description:
Collection links for friends' notes (T-012) and public note submission (T-034): create, list, revoke, the public lookup and the multipart note form. Run against an API started with SMEM_ENV=dev.

Setup, once per database: the owner endpoints need a verified email, and the dev mail is only printed to the API's stdout, which Newman cannot read. So the collection uses three fixed accounts (A, B verified, C never verified): run `newman run postman/notes.postman_collection.json --folder "Setup (once per database)"`, then `make verify-newman-users` (marks A and B verified in the dev database; for another database run `UPDATE users SET email_verified_at = NOW(6) WHERE email IN ('newman-notes-a@example.com','newman-notes-b@example.com')`). After that run the whole collection as often as you like: Setup tolerates accounts that already exist (409, or 429 once the register limit of 5 per hour per IP is used up) and everything else only logs in. Run it in order: Edge cases reuses the users and the yearbook of the Full flow, and ends by deleting the yearbook. Run it from the postman/ directory (`newman run notes.postman_collection.json --working-dir .`) because the note requests upload the photo fixtures of fixtures/media/ (and the Setup command above then needs the same flags). The public routes count only misses (unknown tokens) against 60 per IP per 15 minutes, and a run makes about 8 of them; submissions are limited to 100 per IP per hour, a run makes about 14, so run the whole collection at most 6 times an hour from one address or restart the API. Each run creates its own links, so it can run twice back to back.

item.name: Setup (once per database)
Register A (201; 409 or 429 when an earlier run already did)

exec: pm.test('created, or already there (the register limit is 5 per hour per IP)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 409, 429]));

item.name: Register B (201; 409 or 429 when an earlier run already did)

exec: pm.test('created, or already there (the register limit is 5 per hour per IP)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 409, 429]));

item.name: Register C (stays unverified) (201; 409 or 429 when an earlier run already did)

exec: pm.test('created, or already there (the register limit is 5 per hour per IP)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 409, 429]));

item.name: Full flow

exec: // Once per run, before the first request: a deadline a week ahead for the main link.

item.name: 1. Login A
2. Login B
3. A creates a yearbook
4. A creates a link (label is NFC-trimmed; the token is shown here)
5. A lists: one link, no token or hash anywhere
6. Public lookup, no cookie - 200

exec: pm.test('body', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({yearbook: {title: 'Newman notes book'}, owner: {display_name: pm.collectionVariables.get('nameA')}, deadline_at: pm.collectionVariables.get('deadline'), open: true, fields: pm.response.json().fields}));

pm.test('form fields', () => { const f = pm.response.json().fields; pm.expect(f.map(x => x.id + ':' + x.required)).to.eql(['name:true', 'relationship:false', 'message:true']); pm.expect(f[0]).to.have.keys(['id','kind','label','hint','required','max_length']); pm.expect(f[2].kind).to.eql('long_text'); });

item.name: 7. Public lookup while B is signed in - same answer, B's session is ignored
8. A creates a second link (no label, no deadline)

exec: pm.test('empty label, null deadline, a different token', () => { pm.expect(c.label).to.eql(''); pm.expect(c.deadline_at).to.eql(null); pm.expect(c.token).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('linkToken')); });

item.name: 9. A revokes the first link - 204
10. Revoking again - 204
11. Lookup of the revoked token - 404
12. Lookup of an unknown token - 404, the same answer

exec: pm.test('same message as for a revoked token', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.eql('not found'));

item.name: 13. A lists: newest first, the revoked one has revoked_at
14. A creates a link that expires in 2 seconds

exec: // the API compares whole seconds against the clock, so give it a deadline that is still in the future now

item.name: 15. Lookup after the deadline - 410 collection_closed

exec: const end = Date.now() + 3200; while (Date.now() < end) {} // wait for the deadline to pass

item.name: 16. Friend sends a text-only note - 201, only the id comes back

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('only the id', () => { pm.expect(Object.keys(b)).to.eql(['note']); pm.expect(Object.keys(b.note)).to.eql(['id']); pm.expect(b.note.id).to.match(/^[0-9A-Z]{26}$/); });

item.name: 17. Friend sends emoji, Vietnamese text and two photos - 201

formdata.value: {"name":"Newman Friend","relationship":"classmate","message":"Chúc bạn mãi vui 🎉👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 ❤️ Nguyễn Văn Ánh\n\nHẹn gặp lại!"}

item.name: 18. A bot fills the honeypot - 201 as if stored (nothing is)
19. A lists the links: the two real notes are counted, the bot's is not
Edge cases
Create without a session - 401
List without a session - 401
Revoke without a session - 401
The link token is not a session - 401
Create with the session cookie but no Origin - 403 csrf_origin_mismatch
Revoke with the session cookie but no Origin - 403 csrf_origin_mismatch
Login C (unverified account)
Unverified owner creates a link - 403 email_not_verified
B creates a link on A's yearbook - 404
B lists A's yearbook links - 404
B revokes A's link - 404
A's link still works after B's attempts
Create on a yearbook that does not exist - 404
Revoke a link that does not exist - 404
Label over 60 characters - 400 invalid_label
Label with a control character - 400 invalid_label
Deadline in the past - 400 invalid_deadline
Deadline more than a year ahead - 400 invalid_deadline
Deadline that is not RFC 3339 - 400 invalid_deadline
Unknown field - 400 unknown_field
Malformed JSON - 400 invalid_body
Lookup of a 10 KB token - 404
Lookup of a token with odd characters - 404
Fill the book to 5 active links (1 of 3 more)
Fill the book to 5 active links (2 of 3 more)
Fill the book to 5 active links (3 of 3 more)
A sixth active link - 409 limit_reached
Revoke one link - 204
The slot is free again - 201 (a new token)
Submit: unknown field - 400 unknown_field
Submit: required field missing - 400 missing_answer
Submit: control character in a name - 400 invalid_answer
Submit: answers is not a JSON object - 400 invalid_body
Submit: answers is not JSON - 400 invalid_body
Submit: no answers part - 400 invalid_body
Submit: four photos - 400 too_many_photos
Submit: an HTML page named .jpg - 415 unsupported_media_type
Submit: an empty file - 415 unsupported_media_type
Submit: a GIF - 415 unsupported_media_type
Submit: a decompression bomb PNG - 400 invalid_image
Submit: JSON instead of multipart - 415 unsupported_media_type
Submit: a revoked link - 404 not_found
Submit: an unknown token - 404 not_found
Submit: a malformed token - 404 not_found
Submit: an expired link - 410 collection_closed
Submit: GET on the route - 405 method_not_allowed
After the failures the list still counts two notes
Clean up: A deletes the yearbook - 204
The deleted yearbook's link is gone - 404
